name: llm-request-anatomy
description: Animated isometric figures of one LLM request crossing the OpenEverest + KServe platform

scripts.build: node v1-pneumatic-post/build.mjs && node v1-pneumatic-post/build.mjs --light && node v2-rack/build.mjs && node v2-rack/build.mjs --light && node v3-plan/build.mjs && node v3-plan/build.mjs --light && node scripts/gallery.mjs
scripts.record: node scripts/record.mjs export/v1-pneumatic-post.html --out export && node scripts/record.mjs export/v2-rack.html --out export && node scripts/record.mjs export/v3-plan.html --out export && node scripts/gallery.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/lines.mjs export/v1-pneumatic-post.html && node scripts/lines.mjs export/v2-rack.html && node scripts/lines.mjs export/v3-plan.html
scripts.artifact: node scripts/artifact.mjs export/v1-pneumatic-post.html export/artifact/v1-pneumatic-post.html && node scripts/artifact.mjs export/v2-rack.html export/artifact/v2-rack.html && node scripts/artifact.mjs export/v3-plan.html export/artifact/v3-plan.html
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
